name: RSPWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Billed at Dreamcard V as “the REAL World Championship” — a joke aimed at Ric Flair losing the WWF's own title at WrestleMania the week before — with Flair the reigning champion and Jushin “Thunder” Liger the challenger; the challenge's own result never survives.

name: RSPWF World Jobber Championship
epitaph: Billed at Dreamcard V with Ronnie Garvin the reigning champion against Steve Armstrong's own challenge — a billing one newsgroup reader's own reply to the card protested outright (“Ronnie Garvin is NOT a jobber!!!”). The challenge's own result never survives.

name: RSPWF World Bandwidth Championship
epitaph: Dreamcard's own joke belt, billed at Dreamcard V as the card's own “main event for Part I” — one of the newsgroup’s own regulars under a joke persona defending against another of the newsgroup’s own regulars under a joke persona. Neither name is minted as a character here: the card's own roster policy bills this title's own contenders as “the newsgroup's own regulars,” and the record does not resolve whether the names are real off-newsgroup identities or invented ring personas, so no reign is registered for this belt.

name: RSPWF North American Bandwidth Championship
epitaph: Dreamcard's own joke belt, billed at Dreamcard V with one of the newsgroup’s own regulars, under a joke persona, defending against another. Neither name is minted as a character here: the card's own roster policy bills this title's own contenders as “the newsgroup's own regulars,” and the record does not resolve whether the names are real off-newsgroup identities or invented ring personas, so no reign is registered for this belt.
